product_desc: The Dell Inspiron 7472 is a 14-inch consumer-oriented laptop, part of the Inspiron 7000 series. It features a compact and elegant design with an InfinityEdge display and diamond-cut edges. Released around 2017-2018, it is powered by 8th Generation Intel Core processors and offers a full HD display.

product_features.Display: 14-inch Full HD (1920 x 1080) IPS Truelife LED-Backlit Display
product_features.Processor: 8th Generation Intel Core i5-8250U or i7-8550U
product_features.Graphics: Integrated Intel UHD Graphics 620 (optional NVIDIA GeForce MX150 also available)
product_features.Storage: Hybrid Hard Disk Drive (H-HDD) or SSD + HDD configurations (e.g., 128GB SSD + 1TB HDD, or 256GB SSD)
product_features.Connectivity: Wi-Fi 802.11ac, Bluetooth 4.0/4.1, Gigabit Ethernet, HDMI, USB 3.0, USB 2.0
product_features.Webcam: Integrated Widescreen HD 720P Webcam with Dual Digital Microphone Array
